items.stem: Why is raw data difficult to use? How does classification help?
items.answer: Raw data are unorganised and bulky; classification groups them, reduces bulk, and allows comparison and analysis.
items.markingKey: 3 marks.

items.stem: Give one example each of chronological, spatial, qualitative and quantitative classification from Indian economic data.
items.answer: E.g. India's GDP 2014–2024 (chronological); rice output by state (spatial); workers by gender (qualitative); farms by size in hectares (quantitative).
